final: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(race_count) AS REAL) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM c), s AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, c.race_count / t.total AS share, 1.0 / t.n AS avg_share FROM c, t) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - avg_share AS excess FROM s WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
